latest_interim.detail: Constant currency. Q3 2026: +5% cc (Surgical +4%, Vision Care +6%; IOLs -1% cc on US competitive pressure). FY2026 guidance tightened 10-Nov-2026 to ~+6% cc net sales (from +5-7%); core op. margin +100-150bp cc; core EPS +12-14% cc (TARGET).

geography.basis_note: Net sales by location of third-party customer: United States $4,657m (45%), International $5,662m (55%). Country table (Switzerland, Japan, China, other) exists in the audited notes (Note 4 of the 2025 financial statements) but was not extracted; North America/Europe/China shares not published in the earnings release. No customer >10% of sales.

claim_checks.finding: FY2025 net sales $10,319m: Surgical $5,751m (55.7%; implantables 1,782, consumables 3,028, equipment/other 941) and Vision Care $4,568m (44.3%; contact lenses 2,770, ocular health 1,798).
US 45% / International 55% of FY2025 net sales; US is largest market.

20-F 2025: ~2,650 patent families; 'no single patent, or group of related patents, currently is of material importance in relation to our business as a whole'. No material regulatory action disclosed in Q3-26 release (FDA approval of BRYTLY in Oct-2026). Key recent issues are commercial: IOL competitive pressure in US (IOLs -1% cc Q3-26), legacy contact-lens declines, tariffs (FY26 net impact ~$40m after ~$60m US refund in Q3). Neurotech (ENCELTO) acquisition announced Oct-2026; STAAR deal not completed.

notes: Alcon only reports constant-currency growth, which INCLUDES acquisitions (e.g. ophthalmic pharmaceutical products acquired in 2022; majority interest in Aurion). It is therefore not a strict organic figure; acq_pct left null because the company does not quantify group M&A contribution (except Vision Care 2023: 4pp). fx_pct is derived as reported minus cc (INFERENCE, subject to rounding). China share not extracted (country table is in Note 4 of the audited statements).
